newsitem.title: FRANCE: Strauss-Kahn-will seek savings from all ministries.
newsitem.headline: Strauss-Kahn-will seek savings from all ministries.

text.p: French Finance Minister Dominique Strauss-Kahn said on Wednesday he had asked all government ministers to find budget savings and said there would be no taboos on the choice of budget cuts.
"I have asked all ministers to find savings in all their budgets," he told reporters after a hearing at the parliamentary defence committee.
Asked whether the defence budget would face new reductions in its spending, he answered, "there will be no taboo".
"There are demands which must be met in both directions. In other words, reducing public deficits on one hand and on the other being able to assure government functions," he said.

The new Socialist-led government says it is awaiting the results of an audit of public finances due to be released on Monday before announcing any measures needed to curb the budget deficit this year.
